episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses strategies for real estate agents to leverage past clients and their properties to generate new business. He covers the benefits of turning homes into rental properties, using bridge loans to facilitate new purchases, and how AI is streamlining the mortgage process. These insights provide agents with actionable tactics to help clients unlock equity and expand their real estate portfolios.
